title: She poured in a teacup tea, then back in the teapot tea.
html_source: Two phrases of six words, the fifth word of which has two syllables. The sentence is symmetrical about a comma. The form overrides the meaning and facilitates the musical nature (near nursery rhyme quality) of the sounds.

anchor.text: She poured in a teacup tea, then back in the teapot tea.
